'''Three Toes''' is a pack-leader of [[wolf|wolves]].

==Activities==
Three Toes, along with [[Cold Water]], [[Twilight (wolf)|Twilight]] and [[Springhorn]], are wolves known to [[Perrin Aybara]]. He contacts them to ask for their help in finding his wife, [[Faile Bashere]]. They cannot help.{{Ref/book|9|2}}
